steps.en: A daily list of warrant IDs is built
steps.why_en: No selection of IDs by warrant stage or payment status exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pemilihan ID berdasarkan stage warrant atau payment status.

steps.en: The ID list is sent to DOS
steps.why_en: There is no DOS integration in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada integrasi DOS di sistem.

steps.en: Latest vehicle numbers per ID are received
steps.id: Vehicle number terbaru per ID diterima
steps.why_en: Nothing receives vehicle numbers for tagged IDs.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menerima vehicle number untuk ID tagging.

steps.en: A daily tagging file is generated
steps.why_en: The daily file exists but is built from suspended vehicles, not from DOS results for warrant IDs.
steps.why_id: File harian ada tetapi dibuat dari kendaraan suspended, bukan dari hasil DOS untuk ID warrant.
